an6.83:1.1: chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo aggaṃ dhammaṃ arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ
an6.83:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu asaddho hoti ahiriko hoti anottappī hoti duppañño hoti kāye ca jīvite ca sāpekkho hoti
an6.83:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu abhabbo aggaṃ dhammaṃ arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ.
an6.83:2.1: chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhabbo aggaṃ dhammaṃ arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ
an6.83:2.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saddho hoti hirīmā hoti ottappī hoti āraddhaviriyo hoti paññavā hoti kāye ca jīvite ca anapekkho hoti
an6.83:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhabbo aggaṃ dhammaṃ arahattaṃ sacchikātunti. 84
